recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit only if a current generated Questionnaire extension page is shown to publish incorrect heading levels or if Extension Pack/core integration creates a concrete misleading statement.
issue_request: FHIR-6827 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core correction for the Core extensions for Questionnaire profile page. It asked to fix page numbering so sections on that page were subsections of 4.26.12 rather than 4.26.13, and noted the page should not imply unavailable core extensions; Jira resolved it as fix and comments identify SVN revision 5976.
initial_application: Git history contains the Jira/SVN application: ecbe0afa04bdb05ff6af268a8381db463e9d3352, imported from SVN revision 5976, changed source/questionnaire/questionnaire-extensions-introduction.xml from an h2 Scope and Usage heading to h3 with subject #6827 - top level for a profile introduction is h3 not h2.
additional_context: Questionnaire remains active in source/fhir.ini, the current source already has the h3 heading, and no 4.26.12/4.26.13 literals remain in the Questionnaire/profilelist sources checked. Current HL7-provided Questionnaire extension definitions are present in the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, so the old DSTU1 availability note does not establish a current core defect. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or clarifying community records.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested heading-level/numbering correction is already applied in the current in-scope source, and changing the remaining generic introduction text would not be necessary for current implementer understanding.
